description: Decay process of free residual chlorine concentration affected by travel time in water distribution systems is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Luciano de Oliveira, Diana Rosa dos Reis. Abstract Chlorination is the most widely used method for disinfecting water for human consumption. While the chlorinated water travels through a distribution system, the concentration of free residual chlorine (FRC) declines depending on the natural water characteristics.
